description: Poll a find_money_batch job: status (running/done), progress {done,total,percent}, running total, per-wallet results, ranked items, the verbatim 'summary' and the 'plan'. While running, wait pollAfterSeconds and call again; tell the user progress. When done, relay summary verbatim and walk plan with the sign loop (verify_tx → human yes → wallet signs → broadcast_tx → tx_status). Result includes `display` markdown with chan images: show it to the user. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).
name: find_money_status
title: Progress / result of a find_money_batch job
